playstyle: Drepur's Wraithcreepers are four flying Death elites with solid health and reach weapons that threaten at range 2 without fully committing. Every fighter carries Fly, letting the warband glide over terrain to pick favourable engagements. Their warscroll either rolls a Locus of Shyish to layer buffs and debuffs, inspiring fighters on each kill while the Locus persists, or sacrifices their low-health vassal to stagger enemies while raising fallen comrades back into play. The warband wins through superior board access, controlled pressure, and an inspire engine that rewards picking off exposed targets.
